the 6 x6 flavor mixing matrix is fully parametrized in terms of 30 parameters, which can be divided into three groups of 15 parameters each.

the 15 parameters of the 6x6 flavor mixing matrix can be used to explain the LSND, reactor, and MiniBooNE anomalies, and that the 15 phase angles can be used to describe leptonic CP violation, deformed unitarity, neutrinoless double beta decay, tritium beta-decay, leptogenesis, and the seesaw mechanism.

the (3 + n) scenario with 3 active and n sterile neutrinos is the most general framework for neutrino oscillations, that it allows us to describe the most relevant features of neutrino phenomenology in terms of the 3 + 2n angles and phases, and that it provides a natural setting for the study of neutrino masses, mixings, and CP violation in the type-(II) seesaw and type-I seesaw models.

the 6 x6 flavor mixing matrix is the most general matrix in neutrino physics.
